reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off and toys cleaned after use are exactly what I look for with a baby who mouths everything, and the free first visit plus a free under-1 makes it easy to try. I'd go for the free visit and probably one paid drop-in, not a membership yet.
objection: Is it actually clean? A log on the wall is easy to fill in, I'd want to see the toys and the Baby Nook myself, and read what other parents say, before I trust it with my 10-month-old.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it clean in person on the free visit and a few honest local parent reviews. If the Baby Nook looked grubby or crowded, I would not come back.
